description: This file defines the 'Element' class within the Goteo\'Library\NormalForm namespace, implementing ArrayAccess and Resource interfaces. It manages form element properties, rendering, and view handling for the Goteo project.

classes.name: Element
classes.description: Represents a form element with properties, view rendering, and array access capabilities.

methods.name: offsetGet
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a property by name.

methods.name: offsetSet
methods.description: Sets the value of a property by name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Element object with provided data, sets type and view.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Returns the path to the view template for the element.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type string based on class name.

methods.name: getInnerHTML
methods.description: Returns the rendered inner HTML of the element.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Creates an Element instance with data and renders it.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the element using a view template.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the element, rendering it or terminating on exception.
